topic: Fleet cockpit residual polish: launch footgun, single-instance guard, closeout observability
notes:
Consolidated from dogfood threads thread-c38e005d + thread-b797e515 (now retired). Citations VALIDATED against beta/blackbox-v2 (9cb5228). These are the SMALL cockpit residuals that survived the roster-subscription rewrite (which already fixed: poller death, stale/frozen timers, model/report "—", help overlay, Right-focus on reloaded rows, folded-row persistence, forget persistence, logging live-flush, keep/preflight mismatch — all confirmed RESOLVED this session).

D1 [OPEN] Launch footgun. crates/bro-cli/src/fleet_tui.rs:2558-2560 — in Zone::Roster, any non-slash Enter calls dispatch_current_input() with no shell-vs-prompt guard. Typing a shell command (e.g. `clear; bro fleet`, `cargo build`) into a pane that still owns a live cockpit dispatches it as a one-line agent prompt. Fix shape: heuristic/confirm for shell-shaped input, or a clearer "this dispatches an agent" affordance.

D2 [OPEN] No single-cockpit detection. No flock/pidfile/advisory-lock anywhere in fleet_tui.rs/main.rs/fleet.rs. Two `bro fleet` processes over the same fleet store both subscribe to /control/roster/stream and issue overlapping /control/exec + /control/steer — orphan cockpits duel and corrupt display state (cost real debugging time during dogfood). Fix shape: advisory lock / pidfile on the fleet store dir with a warn-or-refuse on a second instance.

D3 [OPEN] Closeout branch-delete silent failure. crates/bro-tools/src/fleet_worktree.rs:1368 `let _ = git_run(base_repo, &["branch","-D",branch]);` — the PhaseResult always reports ok:true + deleted_branch:branch regardless of whether the delete succeeded. Observability nit, not a leak (verified: closeout DOES reap branches). Fix shape: capture the result, surface a warning on failure.

ADJACENT (surfaced by Explore in passing, verify before acting):
D4 forget_standalone_agents (fleet_tui.rs:2966) swallows daemon DELETE errors (`let _ = app.orch.forget(&id)`) — inconsistent with remove_agent_row's fallible path.
D5 started_at for reloaded rows is hydrated from last_event_at (crates/.../task.rs:175) → the "started" column shows last-activity time, not session start, for reloaded sessions.
D6 roster_subscription_loop reconnect (fleet.rs:~1667) uses a fixed 750ms sleep, no exponential backoff → reconnect spray if the daemon is down >750ms.

OUT OF SCOPE here (major features, design-level, were referenced in the source threads as gap-8c25a414 / gap-72edd4f2 repo_id-scoped render + worktree auto-registration, and gap-be41898e ambient harness retrieval tools — none currently in the unresolved gap set; verify their state separately rather than folding into cockpit polish).

OPERATOR-OBSERVED friction (2026-06-09, live cockpit) — two transient double-render bugs. Not yet root-caused in code; candidates for this track's next tranche.

D7 [OPEN, observed] Dispatching from the roster view briefly shows a DOUBLE ENTRY for the new agent — the row appears twice for a moment, then collapses to one. Likely an optimistic-local-insert racing the roster SSE delta that also carries the new task: the cockpit adds the dispatched agent locally AND the /control/roster/stream RosterDelta::Added/Upserted arrives, so for one frame there are two rows until they reconcile by task_id. Root-cause shape: dedup local optimistic insert against the incoming delta by task_id (or don't optimistic-insert when the subscription will deliver it). Look at dispatch_current_input/dispatch_fleet_prompt local insert vs update_task_from_roster in bro-fleet-client.

D8 [OPEN, observed] The FIRST user turn renders TWICE in the zoomed-in (SingleAgent) transcript view. Likely the focused-transcript stream replays history AND the just-sent first turn is also appended locally (or the SSE backfill includes the turn the cockpit already rendered optimistically) → duplicate first message. Root-cause shape: dedup the focused-transcript backfill against locally-rendered turns (by event id/offset) in start_focused_transcript / the transcript SSE handler. Same family as D7 (optimistic-local vs daemon-delivered duplication).

Both are display-only, self-correcting, low-severity — but they're the same root smell (optimistic local state not deduped against the authoritative daemon stream) and likely share a fix approach.

OPERATOR-OBSERVED friction (2026-06-09, live cockpit).

D9 [OPEN, observed] Navigating to/from an agent (zoom in → out → back, or switching focused agent) LOSES the visible transcript — only the last turn or two render after navigation, instead of the full scrollback that was there. Likely the focused-transcript view drops/never-replays its history buffer on re-focus: start_focused_transcript reopens the SSE stream but the prior backfill/scrollback isn't restored, so only newly-streamed (or the most recent paged) events show. Root-cause shape: on (re)focus, restore the full history buffer for that task — either keep the per-task transcript buffer warm across navigation, or re-request the history page (the daemon focused-transcript subscription supports history paging per commit 777c18e) and render it, not just the tail. Adjacent to D8 (focused-transcript backfill handling) — same subsystem (start_focused_transcript / transcript SSE handler).

OPERATOR-OBSERVED friction (2026-06-09, live cockpit).

D10 [OPEN, observed] When ZOOMED IN on an agent, NEW transcript lines do not appear live — you must navigate out and back in to see them. The focused-transcript SSE stream is arriving (events land) but the zoomed-in view isn't repainting on new focused-transcript events; nav-out/in forces a fresh render/backfill that surfaces them. This is the complement of D9 (nav-out/in LOSES scrollback): D9 = re-focus drops history; D10 = staying focused drops live updates. Together they point at the focused-transcript render loop: the inline zoomed view (run_tui_cockpit inline loop, ~fleet_tui.rs:1786) isn't waking/repainting on FocusedTranscriptMsg::Stream events the way the roster loop repaints on roster deltas. Root-cause shape: ensure the inline/zoomed render loop selects on the focused_transcript_rx and repaints on each Stream event (and appends to the buffer), and that re-focus restores the buffer (D9). D8/D9/D10 are one subsystem — the focused-transcript buffer + inline render loop.

OPERATOR-OBSERVED friction (2026-06-09, live cockpit).

D11 [OPEN, observed] In the zoomed-in (single-agent) view, the activity throbber shows the agent "working" even though the agent is in the Finished (terminal) bucket. The working/spinner indicator in the single-agent view isn't gated on terminal status — it keeps animating for a completed agent. Pairs with D10 (no live updates while zoomed): the zoom view's activity/throbber state is decoupled from the authoritative task status. Root-cause shape: gate the single-agent throbber on snapshot().status.is_terminal() (no spinner once terminal), and ensure the zoom view re-derives status from roster/snapshot rather than a stale local "active" flag set at focus time. Look at single_agent_status_spans / the zoom-view render + whatever drives the throbber animation.

SUBSYSTEM SUMMARY: D8 (first turn double-renders), D9 (re-focus loses scrollback), D10 (no live new lines while zoomed), D11 (throbber says working on a Finished agent) are ALL the focused-transcript / single-agent zoom view. They share a root theme: the zoom view's buffer + status + repaint are not faithfully driven by the daemon focused-transcript stream + authoritative status. Likely best fixed as ONE focused tranche on the inline/zoomed render loop (run_tui_cockpit inline loop ~fleet_tui.rs:1786 + start_focused_transcript + FocusedTranscriptBuffer), not four scattered patches. D7 (roster dispatch double-entry) is separate (optimistic local insert vs roster SSE delta).

D11 LIVE-CONFIRMED via tmux default socket session 1 (read-only capture, 2026-06-09). Zoomed-in view of the completed brodex session (task 6e6ae4be, status=completed, real elapsed ~3m12s per bro_dashboard) shows footer:
  "✢ Agent activity working 10m27s   ·   ○ Classifier off   (brodex gpt-5.5 high)"
  "transcript-search ── \"how do I make fleet TUI…\" ── 0 active - 0 waiting"
Two confirmations in one frame: (1) the single-agent throbber says "working" with a CLIMBING timer (10m27s) for a TERMINAL agent — D11; (2) the SAME footer's roster summary correctly says "0 active - 0 waiting". So the roster status is right but the zoom-view activity indicator + its timer are not derived from authoritative status — they keep a stale "active" flag and a wall-clock-since-focus timer. The 10m27s vs ~3m actual also ties to the started/last timer-derivation issues (D5). Sharp repro for the fix: in the single-agent view, gate the throbber on status.is_terminal() and source the elapsed/age from the same roster snapshot the footer's "0 active" already reads correctly.

Decomposed during thread triage (2026-06-11) into repo-owned project gaps so the work is portable across machines: D1 roster dispatch shell-guard (citation re-verified at fleet_tui.rs:3181) → gap-d7527187; D2 single-instance guard → gap-ddfde5c3; D3+D4 closeout/forget error observability (D3 re-verified ~fleet_worktree.rs:1370) → gap-a268b269; D8+D9+D10+D11+D5 focused-transcript zoom fidelity (D11 already live-confirmed via tmux 2026-06-09) → gap-09cbae98; D7+D6 roster stream optimistic-insert dedup + reconnect backoff → gap-1189200c. ALL gaps carry the operator gate: validate against a live `bro fleet` instance via tmux MCP before fixing (standing order 2026-06-11 + existing repo convention). No fixes actioned in this triage session.
